Inside, look for 20 stained glass windows depicting the 20 mysteries of the rosary and six hand-painted murals above the altar showing scenes from the life of Jesus and the apostles.
editorial.know_before: Group tours are scheduled by appointment; call the parish office ahead rather than expecting a walk-in tour.

facts.claim: there is only one bishop's seat in the Diocese of Orlando and it is at St. James.
Located in the nave and eastern transept of the cathedral, there are 20 stained glass windows depicting the 20 mysteries of the rosary.
Above the Altar, six murals were hand painted and depict important scenes in the life of Jesus and the apostles.
Tours are scheduled for groups by appointment.

supports: Princess Place Preserve, with its rich history and 1500 pristine acres, attracts nature enthusiasts from near and far.
This beautiful 1,500-acre preserve is situated in the northern part of Flagler County.
The original lodge, built by Henry Cutting, stills stands as Flagler County's oldest intact structure.
Visitors can take in its splendor while on one of the many hiking trails, fishing the salt marshes along the Matanzas River and Pellicer Creek, or camping out under the stars.

editorial.hook: 1,500 acres and Flagler's oldest intact lodge

editorial.know_before: Plan for outdoor time on hiking trails and salt marshes; camping under the stars is among the preserve's stated activities.
